item.description:
What's New

  • add Little Snitch Internet Access Policy
  • live streaming output and safe cancellation for long-running commands

Fixes

  • cap persisted action output at 64 KB of UTF-8
  • collapse installed fetches and route background failures non-modally

Performance

  • drain pipes event-driven and re-enable process tests in CI

Documentation

  • add email reporting channel
  • support only the latest released version
  • drop duplicated badges and document the Brewfile trust model

Testing

  • raise SwiftUI coverage with fixture-backed UI tests
